A '''chemical scanner''' was a type of [[Sensor/Legends|scanner]] for detecting chemicals. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], [[Sa'arli]], a [[Tarasin]] [[Aide/Legends|aide]] to the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system's]] [[Senator/Legends|senator]] [[Lavina Durada-Vashne Wren|Lavina Wren]], had access to a [[YT-1300 light freighter/Legends|YT-1300 light freighter]] equipped with a portable chemical scanner. The scanner had a range of 200 [[Meter/Legends|meters]].<ref name="Who Goes Thaere?" />
 
{{RPG|''[[Who Goes Thaere?]]''}}
Circa [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]],<ref name="date">The ''[[Living Force Campaign Guide]]'' states that the [[Living Force (roleplaying campaign)|''Living Force'']] campaign is set one [[Standard year/Legends|year]] after the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]], an event that is dated to [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]] by ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''. As the ''Living Force'' adventure ''[[Below the Belt: Philology]]'' [[Cularin's disappearance|moved]] the campaign forward ten years to the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], ''[[Who Goes Thaere?]]'' is therefore dated to circa [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]].</ref> Sa'arli hired a [[Heroes of Cularin|group of freelance agents]] to investigate suspicious activity on the Cularin [[Star system/Legends|system]] [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Ostfrei]] and loaned them use of the YT-1300 and accompanying chemical sensor for the assignment. During their mission, the group deployed the scanner on the surface of Ostfrei to locate a [[Ostfrei pirate base|hidden pirate base]], by tracking a trail of [[carbonyl]] ions and ionized [[methyl]] that led to the facility.<ref name="Who Goes Thaere?" />
{{Endgame}}
 
==Behind the scenes==
The chemical scanner appeared in the [[Living Force (roleplaying campaign)|''Living Force'']] [[Roleplaying game|roleplaying]] adventure ''[[Who Goes Thaere?]]'', written by [[Ronald A. Heintz]] and released in [[2004]]. In the adventure the players roleplay as the freelance agents hired by Sa'arli to investigate Ostfrei and it is possible for Sa'arli to loan the players the use of the YT-1300 [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] equipped with a chemical scanner for the duration of the assignment. It is then also possible for the players to utilize the scanner to find the [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] base on Ostfrei.<ref name="Who Goes Thaere?" />
